soundness_flags.label: ass:uniform-local-mass
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Aamari–Aaron–Levrard model has one support density and reach conditions, not the proposal's arm-specific r^2 lower-mass condition at every assignment-boundary point; retag and justify this stronger primitive condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:kernel-regularity
soundness_flags.one_line: Cattaneo–Titiunik–Yu Assumption 2(iii) permits a compactly supported Lipschitz kernel but does not impose symmetry or strict positivity on all of (-1,1), so “as in Assumption 2(iii)” is inaccurate.

soundness_flags.label: thm:smooth-exact-frontier / lem:trimmed-two-intersection
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Theorem 3(ii) requires each circle to meet bd(A_t) only twice in B and assumes its circle-level conditional expectations are well-defined; the lemma proves only two intersections with B and the class never requires A_0=X\A_1 or the missing circle-level premise.

soundness_flags.label: prop:straight-boundary-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: A condition on one P having a straight boundary cannot reduce R_{n,delta}(P_sm), whose supremum remains over the entire smooth class; define a straight-boundary subclass and its own minimax risk.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4, Assumption 2(iii)–(v); p. 6, Theorem 3(ii); pp. 9–10, Theorem 6 and following paragraph
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 2(iii) requires either a compactly supported Lipschitz kernel or a uniform kernel with a VC condition; it does not state symmetry or strict positivity. Theorem 3(ii) requires circles to intersect bd(A_t) at only two points in B. Theorem 6 gives the n^{-1/4} lower bound, and the paper says its log^{1/4} uniform-rate gap is conjectured unimprovable because the lower bound is pointwise.

The paper's model is a compact C^2 submanifold with reach bounds and a single density bounded above and below with respect to Hausdorff volume on its support; it has no treatment/control assignment regions or arm-specific boundary-ball mass condition.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: State a primitive local partition/tubular-neighborhood condition implying A_0=X\A_1 locally, the exact bd(A_t) two-intersection property, positive circle-level denominators, and the fixed-estimator Gram bound.
Retag uniform local mass as a novel substantive design-geometry condition and justify realistic geographic/administrative regimes, or prove the rate under a literature-standard condition instead.
Replace the straight-boundary proposition with a risk over an explicitly defined straight-boundary subclass and show its distance-only and full-location benchmark comparison.

recommended_next_step: Revise the kernel and local-mass assumption provenance and repair the smooth-upper-theory premises plus the straight-boundary sanity statement, then return for review.
